div.b: The AWS CLI adds access and firewall

div.span: - The key pair vpc-lab-key and the security group vpc-lab-sg, which allows ICMP, SSH on port 22 from your own IP and HTTP on port 80.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 38px; height: 1px; padding-top: 331px; margin-left: 1271px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FFFFFF;

div.span: - It reads the stack outputs and starts EC2-1 in subnet A and EC2-2 in subnet C. Both subnets assign a public IP on launch and user-data installs Apache.
